newsitem.title: USA: Proactive, Killearn call off combination.
newsitem.headline: Proactive, Killearn call off combination.

text.p: Proactive Technologies Inc said Friday it will not pursue a proposed business combination with Killearn Properties Inc because both companies believe the costs to be too great.

"Continuing on the proposed path of combining these entities would result in incurring accounting, legal and other professional fees that exceed the benefits anticipated to be gained by each company's shareholders," said Proactive president Mark Conner, in a statement.

Proactive said it will continue to explore alternatives in combining both companies, adding that it intends to purchase up to 75,000 shares of Killearn stock should they become available and depending on market conditions.
Killearn stock closed Friday at 6-1/4, unchanged. Proactive shares closed at 13/16, also unchnaged.
Proactive is in the residential and commercial real estate development business with projects located in Tallahassee, Vero Beach and Cape San Blas, Florida, and Albany and Thomasville, Georgia.
Killearn is in the residential and commercial real estate development business in Stockbridge, Georgia.
